summary: The chapter is otherwise strong (67 items with 6-17 per KC, worked+faded examples for all 3 procedural KCs, 5 examiner-sourced misconceptions, flashcards, two embedded diagrams), but both diagrams only show Period 3; the group-down trend and the Period 2 dips that 9701-1.4.3 also asks for are stated in prose with no figure.

improvements.where: note, after the Period 3 diagram under ## Key ideas
improvements.why: 9701-1.4.3 asks to explain trends 'across a period and down a group', but the chapter's only ionisation-energy graphs cover Period 3; nothing shows the sharp drop at the start of a new period (the evidence for the group-down trend) or the Period 2 dips (Be to B, N to O) that the note currently only states as numbers in prose
improvements.what: graph_sketch of first ionisation energy (kJ mol^-1) against proton number for H to Ne (H 1312, He 2372, Li 520, Be 899, B 801, C 1086, N 1402, O 1314, F 1681, Ne 2081), xticklabels H-Ne, annotations on the He-to-Li drop (new outer shell, further from the nucleus, more shielding: the group-down trend) and on the two Period 2 dips Be-to-B (2p higher in energy than 2s) and N-to-O (spin-pair repulsion in 2p4)
